summary: Iteration 18 — RETEST of the iteration-17 CRITICAL Inworld TTS bug. VERDICT: FIXED. (1) Direct probe of integrations.generate_tts_telephony against the live demo org (tts_stt_provider=inworld, real Inworld key): voice_id='george' -> provider=inworld, 27.5KB mulaw audio in 2.32s; voice_id='charlie' -> 26.6KB in 2.30s; voice_id='Ashley' -> 29.4KB in 2.33s; voice_id='definitely_not_a_voice_xyz' -> inworld_error with the real Inworld message 'Unknown voice: definitely_not_a_voice_xyz not found!' in 2.59s (no 20s hang, no empty error). (2) POST /api/campaigns/{id}/warm-cache now returns 200 {ok:true,status:'warming'} in 0.07s (was ~80s + 502); backend log confirms the background task completed 'warmed 4/4 phrases' with the fallback voice Ashley, and a re-POST logs 4/4 cache HITs. (3) Regressions all green: /api/voices returns 100 Inworld voices with provider='inworld' (id/name/gender/accent/display_name present) and the 12-voice ElevenLabs catalog with top-level+per-voice provider='elevenlabs' incl 'george'; /api/settings/integrations/{telnyx,inworld}/test both valid:true with the supplied keys; /api/inworld/voices returns 100 dynamic voices (source=inworld). (4) Frontend: Voices tab renders 100 Inworld cards / 12 ElevenLabs cards; New Campaign + Edit Campaign voice <select> renders 101 options (Inworld) and 13 options (ElevenLabs, 'charlie' correctly preselected) with zero page/console errors; the previously reported translucent New Campaign dialog is now opaque. (5) backend/tests/test_telnyx_inworld.py 24/24 pass. No new critical issues.

minor.issue: Now fire-and-forget (200 {status:'warming'}) so the caller gets no success/failure signal — TTS failures are only visible in server logs. Consider a small status field on the campaign (e.g. tts_cache_warmed_at / last_warm_error) so the UI can surface 'voice failed to synthesize'.

The ElevenLabs->Inworld voice fallback is silent (logs only the substituted voice). A campaign showing 'George (male, British)' will actually speak with the org's Inworld voice (Ashley, female). Log a WARN and/or migrate stored voice_id when the provider is switched.
STILL returns inworld_api_key / provider secrets in plaintext to the browser (carried over from iteration 17, unfixed).
STILL returns gender='neutral' for all 100 Inworld voices, so every card paints the female glyph (carried over from iteration 17).

Full-suite run (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/) = 163 passed / 16 failed / 6 errors. test_telnyx_inworld.py passes 24/24 standalone but 3 tests fail in the combined run due to cross-file asyncio event-loop pollution (RuntimeError: event loop). tests/test_iteration11_owner_features.py and tests/test_iteration12_dialer.py crash at import unless REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is exported (they don't read /app/frontend/.env). Pre-existing, unrelated to this fix.

ui_bugs.component: Campaigns → Edit campaign → AI VOICE select
ui_bugs.issue: When the org's provider is Inworld but the campaign's stored voice_id is an ElevenLabs id ('charlie'/'george'), the select shows '— select —' (blank) instead of the stored value, so the admin cannot see which voice is configured and a Save could clear it. Backend now falls back correctly at synthesis time, so this is a display-only mismatch — show the stored id with a hint (e.g. 'charlie (unavailable for Inworld — will use Ashley)').

critical_code_review_comments: generate_tts_inworld now maps any VOICE_CATALOG id to integ.inworld_tts_voice_id or 'Ashley' and returns result.status.message immediately — verified against the live API for both the ok and unknown-voice paths. Fallback is silent though: consider logger.warning(f'voice {orig} not an Inworld voice; using {voice_id}').

warm_campaign_cache is now consistently fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task in both the POST handler and update_campaign; the task's exceptions are only caught per-phrase inside _warm_campaign_cache — a failure before the loop (e.g. build_campaign_call_context) is swallowed with a bare `except: return 0` and no log line.

rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA (iter 17): Inworld reports voice errors in result.status (code=5 'Unknown voice: george not found!'), which the recv loop ignored, so asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), 20) timed out with an empty str(e) and warm-cache's 4 sequential syntheses hit the ~80s ingress 502. Fix now in place and verified: (a) generate_tts_inworld coerces any voice_id found in VOICE_CATALOG to integ.inworld_tts_voice_id or 'Ashley', (b) it inspects result.status.code!=0 and returns status.message immediately (2.6s), (c) POST /api/campaigns/{id}/warm-cache dispatches _warm_campaign_cache via asyncio.create_task and returns 200 {ok:true,status:'warming'} in 0.07s. Live-API evidence: 'Inworld TTS OK voice=Ashley ... bytes=51416' + 'warm-cache campaign=... warmed 4/4 phrases' in backend.err.log, and cache HITs on the second POST.
